<thought>The 13C NMR shows three signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm): 161.40, 143.85, 130.30 ppm. Three distinct aromatic carbon environments typically correspond to a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which contains six aromatic carbons in total. Therefore, the molecule has 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
